[TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 12:31  
[USER] User asked about the design thinking process and requested an explanation suitable for a grade 7 student.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Design thinking is a creative process used to come up with new ideas and solutions to problems.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The design thinking process involves a set of steps to understand the problem, generate ideas, and test those ideas.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The five steps of the design thinking process are:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Empathize: Understand the needs, wants, and feelings of the people experiencing the problem.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Define: Clearly state the problem and what you want to achieve.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Ideate: Brainstorm as many ideas as possible without judging them, using techniques like mind mapping and sketching.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Prototype: Create a simple version of your solution using materials like paper, cardboard, or clay.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Test: Try out the prototype to see if it works and solves the problem, gathering feedback for improvement.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] By following these five steps, you can use design thinking to come up with creative solutions to problems.
